v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Pilot-ready with supervision; successful post-fix AWS build and repeated premium delivery still unverified
v1.summary: First on-demand AWS builder smoke failed all three design specs before inference; the merged Bedrock output-limit fix has no verified full retest. Independent premium design acceptance, unattended restart, publication and owner handoff remain unproven.

v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.status: Progressing; new team dashboard and store extensions still default-off
v2.summary: Latest merged worker/accounting fixes and an improved team dashboard expand code scope, but Team Dashboard and store functions remain default-off or unproven for real customer recurring outcomes. No verified provider-backed useful cycle from all five workers.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.summary: Approved public marketing site and flagged Team Dashboard merged, but repeat premium site deliveries, complete SaaS and custom-agent delivery, routine autonomy and measured margins/founder time remain unproven.

autonomyProof.note: Representative success/attempt denominator is still unavailable; do not imply the 95–99% V3 mature target has been measured.

founderWorkload.note: Darius minutes are not comprehensively separated from operator effort, customer approvals or specialist review.

dimensions.nextMilestone: Measure paid job margins and Darius intervention time on a representative cohort.

promisesOverreach: Do not equate approved public marketing-site redesign with premium website-builder delivery.
Do not present Team Dashboard, store integrations or optional reader as live-by-default capability.
Do not claim the AWS builder has passed after #329 without a genuine post-fix build receipt.
Do not claim complete supported SaaS/custom-agent delivery or measured 95–99% autonomy and 1–2 weekly founder hours.
founderWorkloadTrend: Unknown: no consistent measured time series separates Darius intervention from customer approval, specialist review or operator effort.
nextActions: Verify the Oct 23 Bedrock fix with a real on-demand AWS builder job that completes design spec, full build and cost settlement.
Independently judge and complete 3 premium website journeys including revisions, publication, export and deliberate safe recovery.
Capture exact deployed SHAs, end-to-end review receipts, spend and founder/operator/customer time, leaving all other new flags off.

assumptions: The website-builder asset/recovery defect is fixed and the merged repair release is deployed and repeatedly proven within roughly 30 days.
SelfOperate receives about 150–500 qualified prospects/visitors over 90 days.
Paid conversion is roughly 1–2% while the product remains supervised.
Supervised delivery capacity remains roughly 2–4 projects per month.
Roughly half to three-quarters of eligible delivered customers retain the $299/month ongoing SelfOperate service after any included period.
